responseText:
Aye, these ancient mechanized constructs were once used by my people to assist in mining operations all throughout the mountains here. When everyone left during the Exodus, the machines were left behind.

What happened after we're still not so sure, but these guys became corrupted and now feed on our Essence to keep themselves powered. It's a gruesome sight to behold.
